exceptions.@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk: Proprietary: 'All rights reserved', used under the Claude Code legal agreements. Required by the Claude Code session adapter and reviewed as a runtime dependency of the Apache-2.0 daemon.
exceptions.@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-*: Per-platform binaries of @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk. Which one is installed depends on the host, so this is a pattern rather than one name, and it carries the same terms.
exceptions.@fontsource-variable/instrument-sans: OFL-1.1 font. The desktop renderer bundles its .woff2 files. OFL-1.1 condition 2 permits bundling the font with software provided each copy contains the font's copyright notice and the license; the desktop app carries both in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt. Condition 1 forbids selling the font by itself, which Domovoi does not do.
exceptions.@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono: OFL-1.1 font, under the same terms and the same notice as @fontsource-variable/instrument-sans.
